# Fere AI Documentation

> Official docs for Fere AI — AI trading agents that each run a unique strategy, agent wallets, the Fere MCP for research and trading, and points.

Product context for AI crawlers also lives at: https://www.fereai.xyz/llms.txt

## Get Started

- [Welcome](https://docs.fereai.xyz/): Pick an agent, fund it, and it trades — or research and trade from your own AI with the Fere MCP.

## Agents

- [Agents](https://docs.fereai.xyz/agents): The agents catalogue, how backtests are run and annualized, starting and funding an agent, settings, stopping, withdrawing, and fees.
- [Wallet & Security](https://docs.fereai.xyz/wallet): Agent wallets, Cash in US dollars, MCP wallets, and Coinbase CDP security.

## Research & Trading via MCP

- [MCP Support](https://docs.fereai.xyz/mcp): Research and trade with Fere from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw, and other MCP clients.

## Rewards

- [Points & Leaderboard](https://docs.fereai.xyz/points): Points from on-chain trading volume, with a weekly leaderboard.
- [Refer & Earn](https://docs.fereai.xyz/refer-and-earn): New fee-share referral program with tiers — coming soon.

## Help & Legal

- [FAQ](https://docs.fereai.xyz/faq): Agents, funding and withdrawing, fees, wallet security, the MCP, and points.
- [Support](https://docs.fereai.xyz/support): Email aron@fereai.xyz or DM @0xAron on X — including custom agents and deploying your own strategy.
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.fereai.xyz/legal/terms): Terms of Use for the FereAI service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.fereai.xyz/legal/privacy): GDPR-aligned privacy practices.
- [Security Policy](https://docs.fereai.xyz/legal/security-policy): Responsible vulnerability disclosure.
